# Udyog Manager brand guide

The product name is **Udyog Manager**. The purchased domain is **udyogmanager.com**, as confirmed by the founder. Domain ownership does not imply that hosting or DNS has been configured.

## Product icon

[Editable SVG icon](../assets/icon.svg)

The rounded green square contains a cream U with three lime ledger lines. It connects the initial of Udyog with organized business records. Use the original proportions and keep clear space around the icon. The SVG can scale for a favicon, website, print, or app artwork; actual app-store exports need their platform-specific dimensions and checks.

## Colours

| Use | Colour |
|---|---|
| Primary green | #123E33 |
| Warm ivory | #F5F2E8 |
| Ledger accent | #CBEA84 |
| Body text | #18372E |
| Secondary text | #59685E |

Use Arial or a compatible sans-serif for the current web package. Keep the product name readable and use dark green text on ivory for long passages. Lime is an accent rather than a small-text colour on white.

## Message

**Core description:** Billing and business records for merchants.

**Supporting line:** Your bills. Your customers. Your business, in view.

**Pricing:** Planned ₹1 per finalized bill through credits. Customer creation is free. Tax presentation and recharge terms remain to be confirmed.

Use “coming soon” until the service launches. Do not add invented customer counts, testimonials, certifications, or a launch date. This is original concept artwork, not a trademark-clearance opinion.
